identity_verification_scope: 552 repository source hashes independently matched exact Git blob bytes; proof ZIP independently verified. ELF, RTL and 104 fixture identities are preserved from source-authenticated CI receipt without re-executing or reacquiring payloads.

runtime_accounting.useful_counter_semantics: Each completed launch checks actual public DUT io_usefulMacs == DenseMacs (21528576); PASS total is twice that verified per-launch value. These are Dense MACs only.
runtime_accounting.padded_fma_semantics: Independent padded reference oracle FMA steps, not measured DUT executed MACs.
runtime_accounting.limitation: Driver retains internal startTicks only for watchdog; BEGIN/END/PASS omit full launch/terminal cycle endpoints and executedMacs. Compact and complete GitHub job log do not retain them. Raw driver log is hash-only in successful compact. Do not substitute last COMMAND global cycle or wall-clock elapsed time.
